name: tool-dev-speakup-ai
description: Personal English conversation coach providing contextual dialogue, grammar feedback, and notebook tracking.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Probe runtime status and Sampling capability.

tools.name: get_scenarios
tools.description: Return the list of available conversation scenarios.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a new coaching session for a given scenario.

parameters.name: scenario
parameters.description: Conversation scenario key (e.g. introduction, job_interview, college, everyday)

tools.name: coach_turn
tools.description: Submit a user answer and receive coaching feedback.

parameters.name: turn_number
parameters.description: Current turn number in the session (1-based)

tools.name: get_notebook
tools.description: Return saved grammar mistakes from the notebook.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of notebook items to return

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by item status: all, new, practising, fixed

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search query matching original text, correction, or rule

tools.name: update_notebook_item
tools.description: Update the status of a saved notebook item.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of notebook item to update

tools.name: delete_notebook_item
tools.description: Delete a notebook item by id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of notebook item to delete

parameters.name: sessions_completed
parameters.description: Count of sessions completed to add

parameters.name: answers_given
parameters.description: Count of answers given to add

tools.name: clear_all_data
tools.description: Delete all stored notebook items and reset progress summary.
